# cellxgene_expression_v

CZ CELLxGENE Discover human single-cell expression per dataset and cell group (tissue x cell
type x disease x assay), every disease, tissue_type and assay, with the native and rolled-up
labels. DENSE over measured genes: a gene the dataset measured but never detected in a group
has a row with mean_log1p_cp10k = 0 and frac_expressing = 0; a dataset that did NOT measure
the gene has no row at all — absence means not measured, never 0. Groups below 50 cells or 3
donors are left out. PRIMARY metrics: mean_log1p_cp10k and frac_expressing;
donor_pseudobulk_mean_cp10k is SECONDARY (linear scale, NULL with fewer than 3 donors, does
not rank). Genes are GENCODE v49; chr uses X=23, Y=24, MT=26. Always filter on chr.

## Scan pruning

Partitioned on `chr`: a literal `chr = <n>` predicate is what keeps a query under the sandbox's per-query scan cap, which BigQuery checks against its partition-pruned estimate before running anything. Clustered on `gene_name`, `gene_id`: an equality on these cuts the bytes actually billed but does not lower that estimate, so it never substitutes for the partition predicate.

## Columns

| column | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chr` | `INT64` | Chromosome (X=23, Y=24, MT=26). Partition column — always filter on it |
| `gene_start` | `INT64` | Gene start (GRCh38) |
| `gene_id` | `STRING` | GENCODE v49 Ensembl gene ID, versioned |
| `gene_name` | `STRING` | GENCODE v49 gene symbol |
| `dataset_id` | `STRING` | CELLxGENE dataset (stable across versions) |
| `dataset_version_id` | `STRING` | CELLxGENE dataset version |
| `collection_name` | `STRING` | CELLxGENE collection name |
| `tissue_ontology_term_id` | `STRING` | Native tissue term |
| `tissue` | `STRING` | Native tissue label |
| `tissue_type` | `STRING` | tissue, organoid or cell culture |
| `tissue_general_ontology_term_id` | `STRING` | Rolled-up tissue term |
| `tissue_general` | `STRING` | Rolled-up tissue label |
| `cell_type_ontology_term_id` | `STRING` | Native Cell Ontology term |
| `cell_type` | `STRING` | Native cell type label |
| `cell_type_rollup_ontology_term_id` | `STRING` | Rolled-up Cell Ontology term |
| `cell_type_rollup` | `STRING` | Rolled-up cell type label |
| `disease_ontology_term_id` | `STRING` | Disease term (PATO:0000461 = normal) |
| `disease` | `STRING` | Disease label |
| `assay_ontology_term_id` | `STRING` | Assay term (EFO) |
| `assay` | `STRING` | Assay label |
| `suspension_type` | `STRING` | cell, nucleus or na |
| `spatial` | `BOOL` | Spatial assay (a Visium spot is not a cell) |
| `n_cells` | `INT64` | Cells in the group |
| `n_donors` | `INT64` | Donors in the group |
| `mean_log1p_cp10k` | `FLOAT64` | PRIMARY: cell-level mean of log1p(CP10k), zeros included; 0 = measured, not detected |
| `frac_expressing` | `FLOAT64` | PRIMARY: fraction of the group's cells with nonzero counts |
| `donor_pseudobulk_mean_cp10k` | `FLOAT64` | SECONDARY, does not rank: donor-pseudobulk mean CP10k (linear scale); NULL with fewer than 3 donors |
| `dataset_key` | `INT64` | Release-local key into cellxgene_datasets_v; do not compare across releases |
| `group_key` | `INT64` | Release-local key into cellxgene_groups_v; do not compare across releases |

## Worked examples

Queries that run against cellxgene_expression_v as written.

### A gene's expression in diseased versus normal cells of one tissue, per dataset

```sql
SELECT dataset_id, cell_type, disease, mean_log1p_cp10k, frac_expressing, n_cells FROM cellxgene_expression_v WHERE chr = 1 AND gene_name = 'CD52' AND tissue_general = 'lung' ORDER BY cell_type, disease
```
